description: Operate nmap and masscan for port/service scanning of in-scope hosts — scan-type selection (SYN/connect/UDP), version and OS detection, NSE vuln scripts, output formats, and the masscan-wide-then-nmap-deep pattern. Load when recon surfaces hosts/IPs and you need open ports, service versions, or OS fingerprints. Signals: nmap, masscan, -sV -sC -O, --script vuln, -p1-65535, --rate, "dnet: Failed to open device", top-ports, -oX.
